architecture.mechanism: Incorporation of plant phenolics into polyolefin-based materials to create active packaging
architecture.intervention: Incorporate antimicrobial plant phenolics into the ethylene-vinyl alcohol layer of the multilayer polymer food packaging film
architecture.expected_effect: The phenolic compounds may reduce moisture plasticization by interacting with water molecules or altering the polymer matrix structure, potentially improving moisture barrier properties
architecture.falsification_test: Compare water vapor transmission rates of ethylene-vinyl alcohol films with and without incorporated plant phenolics under accelerated aging conditions (25°C, 65% RH over 18 months)
